topic.angle: More pyramids in Sudan than in Egypt

body.question: Ancient Kushite kingdoms in present-day northern Sudan built pyramids too. About how many pyramids are known to have been built by the Nubians?
body.reveal: Approximately 255 pyramids are known to have been constructed by the Nubians, more than double the number constructed in Ancient Egypt. They range approximately 6-30 metres (20-98 ft) in height, but rise from fairly small foundation footprints, resulting in tall, narrow structures.

probes.question: Compared with the number built in Ancient Egypt, how many pyramids did the Nubians build?
True or false: Nubian pyramids are tall and narrow, rising from fairly small foundation footprints.
